name: Magomed Tuchalov
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An unbeaten Russian light heavyweight (6-0, age 26) from Dagestan Fighter, 1-0 in the UFC after a decision win over Brendson Ribeiro in July. He built his record in UAE Warriors.

how_they_fight.Striking: Four knockouts in our data (two in R1, two in R2).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Went three rounds in his UFC debut.

patterns: Early finishes on the regional scene
